verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֤י׀ אָג֥וּר בִּן־ יָקֶ֗ה הַמַּ֫שָּׂ֥א נְאֻ֣ם הַ֭גֶּבֶר לְאִֽיתִיאֵ֑ל לְאִ֖יתִיאֵ֣ל וְאֻכָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê ’ā·ḡūr bin- yā·qeh ham·maś·śā nə·’um hag·ge·ḇer lə·’î·ṯî·’êl lə·’î·ṯî·’êl wə·’u·ḵāl
verses.literal: These are the words of Agur son of Jakeh the burden that this man declared to Ithiel I am weary, O God, and worn out
verses.literalPt: PALAVRAS de Agur, filho de Jaque, o masaíta, que proferiu este homem a Itiel, a Itiel e a Ucal:

verses.original: כִּ֤י בַ֣עַר אָנֹכִ֣י מֵאִ֑ישׁ וְלֹֽא־ בִינַ֖ת אָדָ֣ם לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇa·‘ar ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·’îš wə·lō- ḇî·naṯ ’ā·ḏām lî
verses.literal: Surely I am the most ignorant of men and I lack the understanding of a man
verses.literalPt: Na verdade eu sou o mais bruto dos homens, nem mesmo tenho o conhecimento de homem.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ לָמַ֥דְתִּי חָכְמָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים אֵדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- lā·maḏ·tî ḥāḵ·māh wə·ḏa·‘aṯ qə·ḏō·šîm ’ê·ḏā‘
verses.literal: I have not learned wisdom and I have no knowledge . . . of the Holy One
verses.literalPt: Nem aprendi a sabedoria, nem tenho o conhecimento do santo.

verses.original: מִ֤י עָלָֽה־ שָׁמַ֨יִם׀ וַיֵּרַ֡ד מִ֤י אָֽסַף־ ר֨וּחַ׀ בְּחָפְנָ֡יו מִ֤י צָֽרַר־ מַ֨יִם׀ בַּשִּׂמְלָ֗ה מִ֭י הֵקִ֣ים כָּל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ מַה־ שְּׁמ֥וֹ וּמַֽה־ שֶּׁם־ בְּ֝נ֗וֹ כִּ֣י תֵדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: mî ‘ā·lāh- šā·ma·yim way·yê·raḏ mî ’ā·sap̄- rū·aḥ bə·ḥā·p̄ə·nāw mî ṣā·rar- ma·yim baś·śim·lāh mî hê·qîm kāl- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ mah- šə·mōw ū·mah- šem- bə·nōw kî ṯê·ḏā‘
verses.literal: Who has ascended to heaven and come down Who has gathered the wind in His hands Who has bound up the waters in His cloak Who has established all the ends of the earth What is His name and what is the name of His Son surely you know
verses.literalPt: Quem subiu ao céu e desceu? Quem encerrou os ventos nos seus punhos? Quem amarrou as águas numa roupa? Quem estabeleceu todas as extremidades da terra? Qual é o seu nome? E qual é o nome de seu filho, se é que o sabes?

verses.original: כָּל־ אִמְרַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַּ צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לַֽחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’im·raṯ ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ṣə·rū·p̄āh mā·ḡên hū la·ḥō·sîm bōw
verses.literal: Every word of God is flawless He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him
verses.literalPt: Toda a Palavra de Deus é pura; escudo é para os que confiam nele.

verses.original: אַל־ תּ֥וֹסְףְּ עַל־ דְּבָרָ֑יו פֶּן־ יוֹכִ֖יחַ בְּךָ֣ וְנִכְזָֽבְתָּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·wsp ‘al- də·ḇā·rāw pen- yō·w·ḵî·aḥ bə·ḵā wə·niḵ·zā·ḇə·tā
verses.literal: Do not add to His words lest He rebuke you and prove you a liar
verses.literalPt: Nada acrescentes às suas palavras, para que não te repreenda e sejas achado mentiroso.

verses.original: שְׁ֭תַּיִם שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאִתָּ֑ךְ אַל־ תִּמְנַ֥ע מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי בְּטֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ta·yim šā·’al·tî mê·’it·tāḵ ’al- tim·na‘ mim·men·nî bə·ṭe·rem ’ā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Two things I ask . . . of You do not refuse me before I die
verses.literalPt: Duas coisas te pedi; não mas negues, antes que morra:

verses.original: שָׁ֤וְא׀ וּֽדְבַר־ כָּזָ֡ב הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗נִּי רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭עֹשֶׁר אַל־ תִּֽתֶּן־ לִ֑י הַ֝טְרִיפֵ֗נִי לֶ֣חֶם חֻקִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šāw ū·ḏə·ḇar- kā·zāḇ har·ḥêq mim·men·nî rêš wā·‘ō·šer ’al- tit·ten- lî haṭ·rî·p̄ê·nî le·ḥem ḥuq·qî
verses.literal: Keep falsehood and deceitful words far from me Give me neither poverty nor riches feed me with the bread that is my portion
verses.literalPt: Afasta de mim a vaidade e a palavra mentirosa; não me dês nem a pobreza nem a riqueza; mantém-me do pão da minha porção de costume;

verses.original: פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע׀ וְכִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה וּפֶֽן־ אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְגָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: pen ’eś·ba‘ wə·ḵi·ḥaš·tî wə·’ā·mar·tî mî Yah·weh ū·p̄en- ’iw·wā·rêš wə·ḡā·naḇ·tî wə·ṯā·p̄aś·tî šêm ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: Otherwise I may have too much and deny You saying Who is the LORD Or I may become poor and steal profaning the name of my God
verses.literalPt: Para que, porventura, estando farto não te negue, e venha a dizer: Quem é o SENHOR? ou que, empobrecendo, não venha a furtar, e tome o nome de Deus em vão.

verses.original: אַל־ תַּלְשֵׁ֣ן עֶ֭בֶד אֶל־ אֲדֹנוֹ פֶּֽן־ יְקַלֶּלְךָ֥ וְאָשָֽׁמְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tal·šên ‘e·ḇeḏ ’el- ʾă·ḏō·nō pen- yə·qal·lel·ḵā wə·’ā·šā·mə·tā
verses.literal: Do not slander a servant to his master or he will curse you and you will bear the guilt
verses.literalPt: Não acuses o servo diante de seu senhor, para que não te amaldiçoe e tu fiques o culpado.

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר אָבִ֣יו יְקַלֵּ֑ל וְאֶת־ אִ֝מּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְבָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: dō·wr ’ā·ḇîw yə·qal·lêl wə·’eṯ- ’im·mōw lō yə·ḇā·rêḵ
verses.literal: There is a generation of those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers
verses.literalPt: Há uma geração que amaldiçoa a seu pai, e que não bendiz a sua mãe.

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר טָה֣וֹר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וּ֝מִצֹּאָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רֻחָֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: dō·wr ṭā·hō·wr bə·‘ê·nāw ū·miṣ·ṣō·’ā·ṯōw lō ru·ḥāṣ
verses.literal: There is a generation of those who are pure in their own eyes and yet unwashed of their filth
verses.literalPt: Há uma geração que é pura aos seus próprios olhos, mas que nunca foi lavada da sua imundícia.

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר מָה־ רָמ֣וּ עֵינָ֑יו וְ֝עַפְעַפָּ֗יו יִנָּשֵֽׂאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: dō·wr māh- rā·mū ‘ê·nāw wə·‘ap̄·‘ap·pāw yin·nā·śê·’ū
verses.literal: There is a generation how haughty are their eyes and pretentious are their glances
verses.literalPt: Há uma geração cujos olhos são altivos, e as suas pálpebras são sempre levantadas.

verses.original: דּ֤וֹר׀ חֲרָב֣וֹת שִׁנָּיו֮ וּֽמַאֲכָל֪וֹת מְֽתַלְּעֹ֫תָ֥יו לֶאֱכֹ֣ל עֲנִיִּ֣ים מֵאֶ֑רֶץ וְ֝אֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים מֵאָדָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: dō·wr ḥă·rā·ḇō·wṯ šin·nāw ū·ma·’ă·ḵā·lō·wṯ mə·ṯal·lə·‘ō·ṯāw le·’ĕ·ḵōl ‘ă·nî·yîm mê·’e·reṣ wə·’eḇ·yō·w·nîm mê·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: there is a generation whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are knives devouring the oppressed from the earth and the needy from among men
verses.literalPt: Há uma geração cujos dentes são espadas, e cujas queixadas são facas, para consumirem da terra os aflitos, e os necessitados dentre os homens.

verses.original: לַֽעֲלוּקָ֨ה׀ שְׁתֵּ֥י בָנוֹת֮ הַ֤ב׀ הַ֥ב שָׁל֣וֹשׁ הֵ֭נָּה לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא־ אָ֥מְרוּ הֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: la·‘ă·lū·qāh šə·tê ḇā·nō·wṯ haḇ haḇ šā·lō·wōš hên·nāh lō ṯiś·ba‘·nāh ’ar·ba‘ lō- ’ā·mə·rū hō·wn
verses.literal: The leech has two daughters Give and Give There are three things that are never satisfied four that never say Enough
verses.literalPt: A sanguessuga tem duas filhas: Dá e Dá. Estas três coisas nunca se fartam; e com a quarta, nunca dizem: Basta!

verses.original: שְׁאוֹל֮ וְעֹ֪צֶ֫ר רָ֥חַם אֶ֭רֶץ לֹא־ שָׂ֣בְעָה מַּ֑יִם וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לֹא־ אָ֥מְרָה הֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ō·wl wə·‘ō·ṣer rā·ḥam ’e·reṣ lō- śā·ḇə·‘āh ma·yim wə·’êš lō- ’ā·mə·rāh hō·wn
verses.literal: Sheol the barren womb land never satisfied with water and fire that never says Enough
verses.literalPt: A sepultura; a madre estéril; a terra que não se farta de água; e o fogo; nunca dizem: Basta!

verses.original: עַ֤יִן׀ תִּֽלְעַ֣ג לְאָב֮ וְתָב֪וּז לִֽיקֲּהַ֫ת־ אֵ֥ם יִקְּר֥וּהָ עֹרְבֵי־ נַ֑חַל וְֽיֹאכְל֥וּהָ בְנֵי־ נָֽשֶׁר׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘a·yin til·‘aḡ lə·’āḇ wə·ṯā·ḇūz lîq·qă·haṯ- ’êm yiq·qə·rū·hā ‘ō·rə·ḇê- na·ḥal wə·yō·ḵə·lū·hā ḇə·nê- nā·šer
verses.literal: As for the eye that mocks a father and scorns obedience to a mother may the ravens of the valley pluck it out and young vultures devour it
verses.literalPt: Os olhos que zombam do pai, ou desprezam a obediência à mãe, corvos do ribeiro os arrancarão e os filhotes da águia os comerão.

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה הֵ֭מָּה נִפְלְא֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְאַרְבָּע לֹ֣א יְדַעְתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·šāh hêm·māh nip̄·lə·’ū mim·men·nî wə·ʾar·bå̄ʿ lō yə·ḏa‘·tîm
verses.literal: There are three things too wonderful for me four that I cannot understand
verses.literalPt: Estas três coisas me maravilham; e quatro há que não conheço:

verses.original: דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַנֶּ֨שֶׁר׀ בַּשָּׁמַיִם֮ דֶּ֥רֶךְ נָחָ֗שׁ עֲלֵ֫י צ֥וּר דֶּֽרֶךְ־ אֳנִיָּ֥ה בְלֶב־ יָ֑ם וְדֶ֖רֶךְ גֶּ֣בֶר בְּעַלְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: de·reḵ han·ne·šer baš·šā·ma·yim de·reḵ nā·ḥāš ‘ă·lê ṣūr de·reḵ- ’o·nî·yāh ḇə·leḇ- yām wə·ḏe·reḵ ge·ḇer bə·‘al·māh
verses.literal: the way of an eagle in the sky the way of a snake on a rock the way of a ship at sea and the way of a man with a maiden
verses.literalPt: O caminho da águia no ar; o caminho da cobra na penha; o caminho do navio no meio do mar; e o caminho do homem com uma virgem.

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן׀ דֶּ֥רֶךְ אִשָּׁ֗ה מְנָ֫אָ֥פֶת אָ֭כְלָה וּמָ֣חֲתָה פִ֑יהָ וְ֝אָמְרָ֗ה לֹֽא־ פָעַ֥לְתִּי אָֽוֶן׃פ
verses.transliteration: kên de·reḵ ’iš·šāh mə·nā·’ā·p̄eṯ ’ā·ḵə·lāh ū·mā·ḥă·ṯāh p̄î·hā wə·’ā·mə·rāh lō- p̄ā·‘al·tî ’ā·wen
verses.literal: This is the way of an adulteress . . . She eats and wipes her mouth and says I have done nothing wrong
verses.literalPt: O caminho da mulher adúltera é assim: ela come, depois limpa a sua boca e diz: Não fiz nada de mal!

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת שָׁ֭לוֹשׁ רָ֣גְזָה אֶ֑רֶץ וְתַ֥חַת אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא־ תוּכַ֥ל שְׂאֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ lō·wōš rā·ḡə·zāh ’e·reṣ wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ ’ar·ba‘ lō- ṯū·ḵal śə·’êṯ
verses.literal: Under three things the earth trembles under four it cannot . . . bear up
verses.literalPt: Por três coisas se alvoroça a terra; e por quatro que não pode suportar:

verses.original: תַּֽחַת־ עֶ֭בֶד כִּ֣י יִמְל֑וֹךְ וְ֝נָבָ֗ל כִּ֣י יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ- ‘e·ḇeḏ kî yim·lō·wḵ wə·nā·ḇāl kî yiś·ba‘- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: a servant who becomes king a fool who is filled with food
verses.literalPt: Pelo servo, quando reina; e pelo tolo, quando vive na fartura;

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת שְׂ֭נוּאָה כִּ֣י תִבָּעֵ֑ל וְ֝שִׁפְחָ֗ה כִּֽי־ תִירַ֥שׁ גְּבִרְתָּֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ śə·nû·ʾāh kî ṯib·bā·‘êl wə·šip̄·ḥāh kî- ṯî·raš gə·ḇir·tāh
verses.literal: an unloved woman who marries and a maidservant who supplants her mistress
verses.literalPt: Pela mulher odiosa, quando é casada; e pela serva, quando fica herdeira da sua senhora.

verses.original: אַרְבָּ֣עָה הֵ֭ם קְטַנֵּי־ אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הֵ֗מָּה חֲכָמִ֥ים מְחֻכָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·bā·‘āh hêm qə·ṭan·nê- ’ā·reṣ wə·hêm·māh ḥă·ḵā·mîm mə·ḥuk·kā·mîm
verses.literal: Four things on earth . . . are small yet they are exceedingly wise
verses.literalPt: Estas quatro coisas são das menores da terra, porém bem providas de sabedoria:

verses.original: הַ֭נְּמָלִים עַ֣ם לֹא־ עָ֑ז וַיָּכִ֖ינוּ בַקַּ֣יִץ לַחְמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: han·nə·mā·lîm ‘am lō- ‘āz way·yā·ḵî·nū ḇaq·qa·yiṣ laḥ·mām
verses.literal: The ants are creatures of little strength yet they store up their food in the summer
verses.literalPt: As formigas não são um povo forte; todavia no verão preparam a sua comida;

verses.original: שְׁ֭פַנִּים עַ֣ם לֹא־ עָצ֑וּם וַיָּשִׂ֖ימוּ בַסֶּ֣לַע בֵּיתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·p̲an·nîm ‘am lō- ‘ā·ṣūm way·yā·śî·mū ḇas·se·la‘ bê·ṯām
verses.literal: the rock badgers are creatures of little power yet they make their homes in the rocks
verses.literalPt: Os coelhos são um povo débil; e contudo, põem a sua casa na rocha;

verses.original: מֶ֭לֶךְ אֵ֣ין לָאַרְבֶּ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֖א חֹצֵ֣ץ כֻּלּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ ’ên lā·’ar·beh way·yê·ṣê ḥō·ṣêṣ kul·lōw
verses.literal: the locusts have no king yet they all advance in formation
verses.literalPt: Os gafanhotos não têm rei; e contudo todos saem, e em bandos se repartem;

verses.original: שְׂ֭מָמִית בְּיָדַ֣יִם תְּתַפֵּ֑שׂ וְ֝הִ֗יא בְּהֵ֣יכְלֵי מֶֽלֶךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: śə·mā·mît̲ bə·yā·ḏa·yim tə·ṯap·pêś wə·hî bə·hê·ḵə·lê me·leḵ
verses.literal: and the lizard can be caught in one’s hands yet it is found in the palaces of kings
verses.literalPt: A aranha se pendura com as mãos, e está nos palácios dos reis.

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה הֵ֭מָּה מֵיטִ֣יבֵי צָ֑עַד וְ֝אַרְבָּעָ֗ה מֵיטִ֥בֵי לָֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·šāh hêm·māh mê·ṭî·ḇê ṣā·‘aḏ wə·’ar·bā·‘āh mê·ṭi·ḇê lā·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: There are three things that are stately in their stride and four that are impressive in their walk
verses.literalPt: Estes três têm um bom andar, e quatro passeiam airosamente;

verses.original: לַ֭יִשׁ גִּבּ֣וֹר בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה וְלֹא־ יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִפְּנֵי־ כֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: la·yiš gib·bō·wr bab·bə·hê·māh wə·lō- yā·šūḇ mip·pə·nê- ḵōl
verses.literal: a lion mighty among beasts refusing to retreat before anything
verses.literalPt: O leão, o mais forte entre os animais, que não foge de nada;

verses.original: זַרְזִ֣יר מָתְנַ֣יִם אוֹ־ תָ֑יִשׁ וּ֝מֶ֗לֶךְ אַלְק֥וּם עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zar·zîr mā·ṯə·na·yim ’ōw- ṯā·yiš ū·me·leḵ ’al·qūm ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: a strutting rooster . . . . . . a he-goat and a king with his army around him
verses.literalPt: O galgo; o bode também; e o rei a quem não se pode resistir.

verses.original: אִם־ נָבַ֥לְתָּ בְהִתְנַשֵּׂ֑א וְאִם־ זַ֝מּ֗וֹתָ יָ֣ד לְפֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- nā·ḇal·tā ḇə·hiṯ·naś·śê wə·’im- zam·mō·w·ṯā yāḏ lə·p̄eh
verses.literal: If you have foolishly exalted yourself or if you have plotted evil put your hand over your mouth
verses.literalPt: Se procedeste loucamente, exaltando-te, e se planejaste o mal, leva a mão à boca;

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֪יץ חָלָ֡ב י֘וֹצִ֤יא חֶמְאָ֗ה וּֽמִיץ־ אַ֭ף י֣וֹצִיא דָ֑ם וּמִ֥יץ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם י֣וֹצִיא רִֽיב׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî mîṣ ḥā·lāḇ yō·w·ṣî ḥem·’āh ū·mîṣ- ’ap̄ yō·w·ṣî ḏām ū·mîṣ ’ap·pa·yim yō·w·ṣî rîḇ
verses.literal: For as the churning of milk yields butter and the twisting of the nose draws blood so the stirring of anger brings forth strife
verses.literalPt: Porque o mexer do leite produz manteiga, o espremer do nariz produz sangue; assim o forçar da ira produz contenda.
